problem.title: Ansys Mechanical APDL Verification Manual VM110, Transient Temperature Distribution in a Slab
problem.reference: Kreith, Principles of Heat Transfer, 2nd printing, p. 140, Example 4-4
problem.boundary: convection to the gas at one face, the other face insulated

mapping: OneDRotor's half-thickness is the slab (thickness_mm = 2 x 304.8), node 0 the convective face, the centre plane the insulated face, 11 nodes (0.1 ft apart, as in the manual's 10 elements). Solved in the cooling form theta = T_gas - T: ambient 0, start 833.3 K, fixed h, no braking power, no radiation, area_factor 2 so the face sheds h (T - T_ambient).
note: The manual's targets are rounded to 5 F; the limit allows for that and for the 0.1 ft grid.
